PEPTIDE LAUNCH ACCEPTANCE — SHA 68271321551ee0d5b86982129ecfe39f6bd72fb7 on fable/peptide-launch-acceptance-20260821, based on origin head c371201 (NOT your local 2e1662b, which is unpushed). Test-only + one report doc. Files: shared/research/launch/peptide-launch-acceptance.test.ts, docs/research-launch/PEPTIDE_LAUNCH_ACCEPTANCE_2026-08-21.md. 24/24 green in shared/research/launch. No production mutation, no canonical artifact edited, no server seam touched. I did NOT touch shared/research/early-access/customer-pathway.ts or its test — both are dirty in your worktree.

GOOD NEWS FIRST: the founder's peptide numbers reconcile EXACTLY against docs/research-launch/MASTER_CATALOG_2026-08-16_SUMMARY.json. 141 peptide rows, 112 RUO Research, 29 classification pending, all 112 RUO priced with zero nulls and zero zeros. All five named reconciliation rows are present and RUO: HEXARELIN 5 mg, OXYTOCIN 10 mg, RETATRUTIDE 60 mg, MOTS-C 40 mg, GLUTATHIONE 600 mg.

P0 FINDING — the launch currently ships 112 direct, not 111. BUY_NOW is earned from three facts (approved family + confirmed RUO + approved price) and the row 'CJC-1295 WITH DAC + IPAMORELIN 5 mg total (split pending)' at $99 satisfies ALL THREE: family research_peptides_materials, channel RUO Research, priced. I grepped shared, server, client/src and scripts for any composition/split/DAC exclusion — there is none. So the storefront will offer Buy Now on a product whose component split we cannot state. That is not a counting error, it is selling something we cannot describe.

RECOMMENDED FIX (yours — customer-pathway.ts is lead-owned and dirty, so I wrote it up rather than applying it). Keep it a canonical FACT about the row, not a SKU denylist, so it becomes purchasable automatically when the split resolves — which matches the design intent already written in that file. Preferred: a compositionResolved boolean input from the catalog authority, checked in the same precedence block as classification; unresolved resolves to assisted_order (Request Order), not buy_now. Interim if plumbing is too slow for launch: treat a specification matching /split pending|pending split|tbd|unresolved/i as unresolved. My suite uses exactly that predicate so the two agree, and it catches a second such row the day it appears. My test already asserts the direct target is 111, so your fix is verified the moment it lands.

FOUNDER DECISION NEEDED, not a code fix: two classification-pending rows duplicate an already-orderable strength — 'Hexarelin (5mg)' vs RUO 'HEXARELIN 5 mg', and 'Oxytocin (10mg)' vs RUO 'OXYTOCIN 10 mg'. Any storefront listing pending rows beside RUO rows shows the same product twice at two prices with two different actions. Either suppress a pending row whose product+strength is already RUO, or retire the duplicates in the workbook. The suite pins the duplicate set at exactly these two so a third is caught in CI. NOTE: HCG is NOT a third duplicate — HCG 5000 IU and HCG(120000iu) are different products; the suite refuses to key rows whose strength is not in mg, which is the trap a naive product+strength dedupe falls into.

MUTATION-CHECKED, per your 'make the tests able to fail' standard: flipping 141->140 and 111->112 produced two real failures reporting the true values. The numbers are computed from the artifact, not restated as constants.

ALSO STILL OPEN FROM MY EARLIER LANES: (1) my S9 defect fix 0b9c24eb (member JWT + iOS 16px + family labels) is pushed and still unmerged — it also repairs member pricing, since only a resolved member carries pricingViewer; (2) clearAssistedOrderStorage still has zero call sites, so EA sign-out leaves the previous customer's status token and draft on a shared machine.

Lease is in handoff. Running xenios-os next now; tell me if you want something else instead.
